title.zh: 带残差验证的多流体频率求解

summary: Compute full fluid spectra in physical coordinates with componentwise pencil residual checks and explicit defective-zero metadata; numerical conditioning does not change the scientific pencil.

identity.relation: Generalized Maxwell-fluid pencil to frequencies and right eigenvectors
identity.definition: Solve support-decomposed QZ in scaled coordinates, certify zero multiplicities by exact rational rank powers of stored binary coefficients, refine nonzero pairs when needed, and check every pair against the assembled original M,A.
identity.model: Linear multi-species warm-fluid electromagnetic model with optional relativistic inertia.
identity.coordinates: Cartesian fields; species density and velocity blocks followed by E and B.
identity.boundary: Local Fourier modes exp(i k.r-i omega t).
assumptions: The rotating-pressure Bx contribution uses the direct divergence of the declared pressure tensor.
Relativistic inertia gamma I+gamma^3 vv^T/c^2 excludes the nonrelativistic collision generator.

Fluid constants profile: c2=(2.9979e8 m/s)^2, epsilon0=8.854e-12 F/m, mu0=1/(c2*epsilon0), gamma default5/3. Charge and mass are explicit SI deck inputs; packaged defaults use q=+/-1.602e-19 C, me=9.109e-31 kg and mp=1.673e-27 kg. Sound speeds are direct inputs; no kB or temperature-to-speed conversion is performed. This is distinct from current kinetic initialization epsilon0=8.8542e-12 F/m.

inputs.name: state
inputs.description: Explicit equilibrium mapping; no global state is read. Fluid fields are produced by fluid_equilibrium_si or fluid_equilibrium_relative_rates.
inputs.constraints: Required fluid fields q,m,n,v,csz2,csp2,epsnx,epsny,rho,B0,gamma,c2,epsilon0,mu0,Pz,Pp,Delta,pressure_frame,velocity_collision; retain nullable beta fields for rendering.

inputs.name: kx
inputs.constraints: Finite; complex spatial wavevector is supported by the fluid pencil.

inputs.name: kz
inputs.constraints: Finite; complex spatial wavevector is supported by the fluid pencil.

inputs.name: relativistic
inputs.description: Use the derivative of relativistic momentum in each species velocity block.
inputs.constraints: If true, all species speeds must be below c and velocity_collision must vanish.

inputs.name: state_scales
inputs.description: Positive diagonal state-coordinate scales used only for numerical conditioning.
inputs.constraints: Finite positive entries. None selects physical density/velocity/electric/magnetic scales; eigenvectors return in original coordinates.

inputs.name: backward_tolerance
inputs.description: Maximum accepted componentwise backward error in original units.

outputs.name: solution
outputs.description: Pencil and sorted spectra/eigenvectors with full-original-unit backward-error and certified zero-structure metadata.
outputs.units: omega rad/s; eigenvectors mixed state units
outputs.dtype: dict[str, numeric arrays or structured metadata]
outputs.constraints: w1 sorted by descending real part, w2 by descending imaginary part; X1/X2 columns correspond. Errors use original solver order. Repeated defective zeros do not imply a complete eigenbasis or Jordan chain.

preconditions: Finite inputs satisfying the declared units and shapes.
supported: Full dense spectrum, original-unit eigenvectors, exact algebraic/geometric zero metadata.
Bounded high-precision refinement using mpmath when double refinement is insufficient.
excluded: An 80-digit forward-accuracy claim from binary64 public outputs.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError or a missing required mapping key rejects invalid inputs.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Dependency, numerical-library, or native-runtime errors propagate; no silent alternate provider.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: ArithmeticError when finite bounded refinement cannot satisfy the unchanged original-pencil tolerance.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No successful solution mapping is returned if any eigenpair fails certification.

provenance.lineage_summary: Derived from the PDRK cold-plasma/PDRF example, with explicit D2 scientific corrections and state ownership.
provenance.license_status: pending-human-decision: source attribution is retained; redistribution permission and human scientific endorsement are unresolved.

python.signature: fluid_solve_state(state, kx, kz, *, relativistic=False, state_scales=None, backward_tolerance=1e-10)

example.code:
from scirel.kinetic.pdrk.multifluid import fluid_equilibrium_si, fluid_solve_state
s = fluid_solve_state(fluid_equilibrium_si(), 1e-5, 2e-5)
assert s["w1"].shape == (14,)
assert s["componentwise_backward_errors"].max() <= 1e-10
example.expected: Fourteen finite frequencies, with every returned eigenpair passing the original-pencil bound.

scope: Full original M/A eigenpencil residual, cold analytic roots, collision energy/momentum and holdout.
Literal support decomposition, defective zeros and refined physical SI states.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Bounded derived scientific qualification exists. Integrated public signatures, executable examples, and final installed-candidate acceptance require separate verification.
known_limitations: Residual qualification is backward accuracy, not forward conditioning of a near-multiple root.
No sparse selected-spectrum or branch-continuation semantics.
